Hamilton County Sheriff’s Office

# Request a Deputy

## Hiring Off-Duty Deputies

Deputies are available for private hire during their off-duty hours at the request of citizens, organizations, and businesses. These deputies can assist the community by providing law enforcement services relating to crowd control, traffic control and security.  Deputies are available on short notice, long-term placements and for all your security needs.

To submit a request for an off-duty Deputy, please complete and submit the form below.
